plugins.name: build-standards
plugins.description: Open build standards for 11 back-office workflows: Database Reactivation, Debtor Chasing, Booked After Hours, Quote Out, Rent Arrears, Fire Service Pack, Multi Site Conformance, Cited Answer, Compliance Calendar, Invoice Check, Rejected Pack. Each carries ordered checks, object schemas, a conformance checklist and a pass test.
